new: A new first story, Your guide: a robot guide stands with you in VR or AR and shows how to point, press, use the menu, the markers and a shared room, then lets you practise.
The guide is drawn by the same code as people's bodies: a story can now make its own figures, with parts that light up, go dark or flash.
People's bodies in a room look and cost the same as before.
test: Play Your guide in VR and in AR on a Quest from start to practice; try every practice task.
With narration off and sound on, check that the guide holds and points at the Sound button until you turn narration on.
Go into a shared room with two headsets and check that people's bodies look as they did in v172.
On a phone and a laptop, play the tutorial through and open its explore mode.
untested: The guide's look, steps and glides on a real headset, and how near it feels.
The AR floor the guide stands on, read from the headset's planes.
The sounds and the synthetic voice are unheard.
